mechanism.claim: A tail change in log(VXEEM/GVZ) identifies rotation between emerging-market systemic uncertainty and gold safe-haven uncertainty. In a high-variation BTC regime, fade the relative uncertainty shock for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of relative_volatility_change; no BTC direction confirmation
mechanism.why_distinct: EMVCR compared VXEEM with VIX and GVRCR compared GVZ with VIX. ESVRR removes the shared broad-equity denominator and directly measures the relative allocation of uncertainty between emerging-market and gold safe-haven risk.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC prior-24h realized-variation strict-prior decision rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Gross9 has no exact VXEEM-versus-GVZ relative-volatility tail clock

features.common_source_dates: exact intersection of source dates having one positive finite close for both VXEEM and GVZ
features.relative_volatility: log(VXEEM_close/GVZ_close) on exact common source date S
features.relative_volatility_change: relative_volatility(S)-relative_volatility(previous exact common source date); strict nonzero

absolute_change_rank.history: at most 252 strictly prior common-source-date absolute relative-volatility changes; minimum 126; current excluded

features.availability: source date S close is usable only at 09:30 America/New_York on the next exact common Cboe source date D
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum(log(close/open)^2)) over the exact 1440 unique BTCUSDT 1m rows in [D 09:30 America/New_York-24 elapsed hours,D 09:30 America/New_York)

btc_variation_rank.history: at most 252 strictly prior valid decision variations; minimum 126; current excluded

features.missing_duplicate_nonpositive_or_nonfini: source failure or ineligible as applicable; no imputation

clock.decision: next exact common Cboe source date D at 09:30 America/New_York, after source S and the exact prior-24h BTC variation path are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages and economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final and strict economics

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent emerging-versus-safe-haven uncertainty-rotation mechanism frozen without candidate incidence, outcomes, or Gross9 results

stopping_rule: terminal first failure: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics, then RV20 audit; no source, ratio, change, rank, side, hold, clock, volatility, subset, comparator, or control repair
